messages:
elena.peopleops: Heads-up — courier left a large crate + a potted ficus by the lobby wheelie at 6:12pm. Plant is tipped, crate labelled 'Demo Kit - ACME'. No visitor sign-in yet for tomorrow. Anyone around to move the crate to the staging room? :eyes: 
samir: On my way in 10m, can grab the roller cart. Where do you want it?
frontdesk-bot: Automated note: Visitor badge request queue has 2 pending submissions for tomorrow (09:30, 14:00). Please confirm host approvals.
morgan: I can meet you at the lobby. If the plant is leaking soil we should tarp the floor — there's already one wet patch by the sofas. :grimacing:
elena.peopleops: Thanks. If someone can secure the crate we can mark it 'hold for ACME demo' and put it in Staging B (behind lockers). Also need a temp badge for a contractor arriving 08:45 — host is @samir.
samir: Got it — badge request approved. @frontdesk-bot can you pre-print a temp badge and label it 'Samir guest — Contractor'?
frontdesk-bot: Badge printed: BadgeID 8921. Placed in Drawer A2.
avery: Quick ask — is there an extra folding chair we can borrow for the demo table? If not I can bring one.
morgan: There's a stack in the storage closet behind the kitchen (Shelf C). If @elena.peopleops confirms I'll move one to the meeting room.
elena.peopleops: Please do, and also can someone snap a pic of the crate label and drop it here? We need courier tracking if Acme claims it.
samir: Uploaded photo: https://files.redwood/example-crate.jpg — label reads "Demo Kit - ACME / Handle with care". Also taped a sticky note "DO NOT OPEN - CONTACT SAMIR".
morgan: Cart moved crate to Staging B. Planted ficus upright and watered (light). Cleaned soil from sofa area. :white_check_mark:
elena.peopleops: Amazing — thank you! I'll add an entry to the visitor binder for the contractor and leave the temp badge in Drawer A2. If anyone is doing mail sweeps tomorrow morning, please bring the crate key (stamped on the label) to the front desk so we can release it to ACME only.
avery: I can do the 8:15 sweep. Anyone want extra coffee? :coffee:
samir: I'll take one. Thanks team!
